ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, points A, B, and C are three points on the circle $ \odot O$. If $ \angle BAC=40^\circ$, what is the degree measure of $ \angle BOC$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Given that $\because \angle BOC=2\angle BAC$ and $\angle BAC=40^\circ$, \\
$\therefore \angle BOC=2\times 40^\circ=\boxed{80^\circ}$.

In the figure, A and B, and A and C are connected, so ∠BAC is an inscribed angle with its vertex on the circumference; at the same time, O and B, and O and C are connected, so ∠BOC is a central angle with its vertex at the center O. They both correspond to the same arc BC. Reasoning: The central angle subtended by the same arc is equal to 2 times the inscribed angle, so ∠BOC = 2∠BAC.
